prompts.blast: Use case: stylized-concept. Game VFX sprite for Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup. a single bold orange and golden yellow explosive impact ring, jagged chunky starburst outline and hollow transparent centre, 6 thick outward spikes, unified silhouette. Tiny authentic low-resolution pixel art, design on a 24 by 24 pixel grid, hard square pixels, 5 colors maximum, thick bright edges with very thin dark purple outline. Isolated centered effect only, actual transparent background. Bold clear shape visible against dark stone and monster sprites. No micro particles, no repeated pattern, no object, no bottle, no character, no text, no soft glow, no blur, no realistic lighting. Leave transparent gaps so monster underneath remains partly visible.
